author: ojiudezue
title: Onboarding: phase 1 already shipped (board was wrong); phase 2 bulk rooms-from-areas ships before second-home go-live; coordinators to be added one-by-one
summary: Audit found ONBOARDING-SIMPLIFY-1 phase 1 (5-screen room chain) shipped in v5.101.0 despite a groom note saying never built. Remaining friction is repetition (6 screens/room, ~67 screens for a 10-room house). Phase 2 = Simple House form (3 fields), bulk 'rooms from areas' (one submit creates all rooms), shorter single-room path, dead-step removal. Operator chose to ship it before the Oct 3-4 second-home setup. Operator also wants coordinators added one-by-one from the CM menu (created disabled until configured) as a per-feature monetization gate.
why: URA is going multi-house; onboarding is the gate to reuse and the first real user of it is the operator this weekend. Bulk creation cuts ~63 screens to ~3 by reusing existing area ranking + room-type defaults through one shared builder. Shipping before go-live trades live-untested risk for an hour of setup saved; the single-room path remains as fallback and re-runs are idempotent (name-checked). Coordinators-as-add-ons: HVAC/Energy/Security are large modules; explicit add gives a natural monetization and complexity gate.
implications: Bulk create runs N room setups inside one HTTP submit; closing the tab mid-run can leave one room half-set up until restart (re-run safe). Duplicate check is by name only. New 'Add rooms from areas' menu entry is visible on existing installs. CM-COORDINATORS-ADD-ONE-BY-ONE-1 supersedes phase 2's S4 dead-end fix once built.
revisit_trigger: Live bulk-create wall-clock for N>=10 approaching HA request timeouts -> move creation to a background job with progress. A second paying house -> prioritise coordinator add-on gating.
